Session Detail Explorations
14Session detail · no Undo after a swiped set

Owner (2026-11-25), after the slide-out delete was built: “I don’t think we need the undo because you can just discard changes by exiting out … So I actually don’t know if we need the undo.” Claude agreed: edit works on a draft, nothing is saved until ✓, closing with changes asks to discard, and iOS edit modes don’t offer Undo per row. Owner: “yup drop it.” Replaces the Undo toast locked on 2026-11-10; the turns before are left as they were.

The Session Detail Demo in edit: swiped, sliding out, the gap closing, closed, and a moment later. No toast; the sets renumber. A wrong delete is put back by closing without saving, or with Add set.

14aSwipe › trash removes the set, with no toast and no UndoLocked

Tap a reps number and type a digit, tick a protocol, or change the start time: it turns blue. Put the value back and it goes grey again. Tap ✓ to save (grey again), or close with changes to get Discard Changes.

Done starts grey and does nothing. Change anything (a number, a protocol, the date, start or duration) and it turns blue. Close with changes asks to discard; close without changes just leaves. Tap any number: a number pad comes up with the field selected, so typing replaces it. ↑ ↓ step to the previous or next field; Done closes. Whatever you tap scrolls to the middle of the space between the bar and the keyboard, so a field is never hidden. Swipe a set left for a trash button (Undo in the toast). Tap Date, Start or Duration to open its picker in place. Add exercise opens the sheet. Tap a protocol to tick it.

6Session detail · exercise cards

Owner after turn 5: 5a locked (long, short, long, short). Exercise cards are too long. Header gets the target RPE beside the target (“Target 4 × 5 · RPE 8”), actual RPE stays top right. Cards must handle bodyweight lifts (reps only, e.g. Plyo Push-up) and timed ones (seconds, e.g. Copenhagen Plank) as well as weight and reps. A miss stays grey; the switch above each phone shows the actual number alone or against the target.

The moss line under a lift only appears when that lift set a PR in this session, under the app-wide rule: a rep record (heaviest weight for 1, 3, 5, 8, 12 or 15 reps) or an estimated 1RM above the previous best, with the gain (+6). No PR, no line. Mock lifts are mixed for coverage, not a real program day.

2Session detail · read and edit in place

Owner after turn 1: date title good; top card too cluttered; leaning 1a because editing happens in place; RPE is per exercise, not per set; no “+” on added weight; misses must show. Both phones: a calmer top card (session, time range, Time · Sets · PRs) with recovery, sleep, strain and the run moved to their own “That day” card; exercises show the target and RPE once.

Edit mode (Read / Edit above each phone, or ••• › Edit session): close on the left, a blue ✓ Done on the right, “Edit session” title. The top card opens into a short list of what can change: Date, Start, Duration (end time follows). Session name and program position come from the program; recovery, sleep, strain and the run come from their own sources, so they aren’t here. Protocols can be ticked on or off. Delete stays in the ••• menu.
